definitions.gloss: sole of the foot; bottom of the foot
definitions.explanation: The underside of the foot. Commonly referenced in contexts of health, massage, reflexology, and physical sensation.

examples.japanese: {足裏|あしうら}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧。
⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{足裏|あしうら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: Walking on the sandy beach feels good on the soles of your feet.

examples.japanese: {足裏|あしうら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ツボ→ツボ：28424_tsubo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that there are many pressure points on the soles of the feet.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot) + ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (underside/back). A straightforward body-part term commonly seen in health and wellness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足裏|あしうら}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧: foot sole massage
- {足裏|あしうら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ツボ→ツボ：28424_tsubo⟧: pressure points on the sole
- {足裏|あしうら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: the soles hurt
- {足裏|あしうら}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: foot sole care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: sole of the foot — the same meaning expressed as a phrase rather than a compound
- ⟦{土踏|つちふ}まず→土踏まず：08543_tsuchifumazu⟧: arch of the foot — the concave part of the sole
- ⟦{踵|かかと}→踵：04265_kakato⟧: heel — the back bottom part of the foot
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧: foot/leg — the general term
